nodes.title: New Horizons
nodes.body:
The sun rises over the fractured lands as you emerge from the underground passages. Your faction's colors now mark you as one of their own, and the path ahead branches according to the allegiance you've sworn.

Word has reached the faction leaders of your arrival. An audience has been requested—your reputation precedes you, and important decisions await.

choices.text: Travel to the faction stronghold for your audience
Explore the surrounding lands before presenting yourself

nodes.title: The Road to Power
nodes.body:
The journey to your faction's stronghold takes you through diverse terrain. The roads are busy with travelers, merchants, and soldiers—all bearing the signs of the ongoing conflict between factions.

As you travel, you notice a commotion ahead. A group of travelers is being harassed by bandits.

choices.text: Intervene on behalf of the travelers
Observe from a distance and gather information
Take a longer route to avoid trouble

nodes.title: Highway Justice
nodes.body:
You charge into the fray, surprising the bandits with your sudden assault. The travelers—a merchant family—cower behind their cart as steel clashes.

The bandits are numerous but poorly trained. Within minutes, three lie unconscious and the rest have fled into the hills.

nodes.title: Patient Watching
nodes.body:
From your hidden vantage point, you observe the bandits carefully. They wear mismatched armor, but their leader bears a sigil you recognize—deserters from one of the faction armies.

After taking what they want, the bandits head east toward the hills. You've learned something valuable about the lawlessness spreading across the realm.

choices.text: Follow the bandits to their camp

nodes.title: A Merchant's Thanks
nodes.body:
The merchant, a rotund man named Aldric, clasps your hands gratefully. 'You've saved our lives! These roads have grown dangerous—the factions care only for their wars, not for common folk.'

He presses a pouch of coins into your palm. 'Take this, and know that the Merchant's Guild remembers those who help its members. If you ever need supplies or information, seek out our sign.'
nodes.speaker: Aldric

choices.text: Refuse payment—you did what was right

nodes.title: Den of Thieves
nodes.body:
You track the bandits to their camp—a collection of tents hidden in a rocky ravine. There are perhaps two dozen of them, too many to fight directly.

But you notice something interesting: crates marked with faction symbols. These aren't just bandits—they're intercepting supply shipments. This information could be valuable.

choices.text: Report this location to the authorities

nodes.title: Secrets Stolen
nodes.body:
Moving silently through the camp, you find manifests and letters in the leader's tent. The truth is worse than you suspected—these bandits are being paid by someone within the factions to disrupt supply lines.

A signature at the bottom of one letter reads: 'S.B.' The Shadow Broker, perhaps?

nodes.title: The Frontier Lands
nodes.body:
The lands between faction territories are wild and lawless—but also full of opportunity. Ancient ruins dot the hillsides, and rumors speak of treasures left behind by civilizations long fallen.

As you explore, you come across three points of interest: a crumbling watchtower, an overgrown temple, and a merchant caravan making camp.

nodes.title: The Abandoned Watchtower
nodes.body:
The watchtower offers a commanding view of the surrounding lands. From its top, you can see the strongholds of all three factions—distant but distinct on the horizon.

Among the debris, you find old tactical maps showing troop movements from a war long past. Some of the marked paths still exist—hidden routes that could prove useful.

nodes.title: Temple of Forgotten Gods
nodes.body:
The temple is older than any faction—a remnant of when the land was whole. Vines cover the entrance, but the interior is surprisingly well-preserved.

At the heart of the temple, you find an altar with three offerings: a warrior's medallion, a scholar's lens, and a merchant's scale. Each seems to call to something within you.

nodes.title: Travelers' Rest
nodes.body:
The caravan master, a shrewd woman named Mira, welcomes you to their fire. 'Dangerous to travel alone these days,' she observes. 'The factions grow more aggressive, and bandits prey on whoever's left.'

She offers you a warm meal and news from across the realm. In exchange, she asks only for stories from your travels.
nodes.speaker: Mira

choices.text: Share tales of your journey so far

nodes.title: News from Afar
nodes.body:
Mira listens to your tales with evident interest, then shares her own observations. 'The Shadow Conclave has been recruiting heavily. The Northern Alliance lost a border fortress. And the Golden Circle...' She lowers her voice. 'They say someone's been stealing from their vaults.'

She hands you a small token. 'Show this at any caravan bearing my sign. You'll find friends there.'
nodes.speaker: Mira

choices.text: Thank her and continue your journey

nodes.title: Whispers of Opportunity
nodes.body:
Mira's eyes gleam. 'Looking for work, are you? I hear the factions are always looking for capable agents. But if you want something... less official...'

She leans closer. 'There's talk of a vault job. Big score, big risk. The kind of thing that could set someone up for life—or get them killed. Interested?'
nodes.speaker: Mira

choices.text: Tell me more about this vault

nodes.title: The Score
nodes.body:
Mira sketches a rough map in the dirt. 'The old fortress at Blackrock Pass—it's been converted into a treasury. Three factions use it as neutral ground to store their most valuable assets.'

She taps the drawing. 'Heavy security, magical wards, the works. But every vault has weaknesses. I know someone who's putting together a team. Meet them at the Crow's Nest tavern in the frontier town.'
nodes.speaker: Mira

nodes.title: Audience with the Leader
nodes.body:
You stand before the faction leader, a figure of immense power and cunning. Their eyes assess you, weighing your worth against the challenges ahead.

'We have watched your progress,' the leader says. 'You show promise. But promise alone does not win wars. We have a quest—one that could turn the tide of this conflict. Will you hear what we offer?'
nodes.speaker: Faction Leader

choices.text: I am honored. Tell me of this quest.
(Your faction standing is too low for an audience)

nodes.title: Turned Away
nodes.body:
The guards bar your path. 'The leader has no time for those who haven't proven their loyalty,' one says coldly. 'Return when you've demonstrated your worth to the faction.'

You are dismissed, but perhaps there are other paths to power...

nodes.title: The Great Quest
nodes.body:
The leader unfolds a ancient map, pointing to a distant fortress. 'The enemy holds an artifact of immense power—one that could secure our victory or ensure our doom. We need someone to retrieve it.'

They look at you directly. 'This quest will be dangerous. Many have tried and failed. But success would elevate you to the highest ranks of our order. What say you?'
nodes.speaker: Faction Leader

choices.text: I accept this quest. The artifact will be ours.
choices.tooltip: Accept the main quest for your faction

choices.text: I am not ready for such a burden. I must decline.

nodes.title: The Journey Begins
nodes.body: The faction leader's quest sends you on a perilous journey to retrieve the artifact. The path varies depending on your faction allegiance—each artifact lies in a different stronghold, guarded by ancient protections.

nodes.title: The Northern Citadel
nodes.body:
The journey north takes you through frozen mountain passes and abandoned fortresses. The Northern Alliance once controlled all these lands, but war has pushed their borders back.

At last, the ancient citadel rises before you—a fortress built into the mountainside, its stones carved with the symbols of forgotten kings.

nodes.title: The Guardian's Challenge
nodes.body:
An ancient spirit materializes before the gates—a spectral warrior in armor of a bygone age. 'Only those worthy of the Crown may pass,' it intones. 'Prove your worth in combat, or be destroyed.'

The ghost draws a sword of ethereal light. This will not be an easy fight.

nodes.title: Hidden Entrance
nodes.body:
Your scouting reveals a partially collapsed section of wall—a secret entrance, perhaps used by ancient kings to escape in times of siege.

The passage is narrow and dark, but it bypasses the main defenses entirely.

nodes.title: The Crown of the North
nodes.body:
In the heart of the citadel, upon a throne of ice and stone, rests the Crown of the North. It gleams with an inner light, and you feel the weight of history as you approach.

As you lift it, visions flash through your mind—great kings, terrible wars, and the unification of the northern tribes. This crown carries the legitimacy of centuries.

nodes.title: The Shadow Depths
nodes.body:
The Shadow Conclave's artifact lies beneath the earth, in caverns that have never seen sunlight. The entrance is hidden within an ancient library, accessible only to those who know the secret words.

As you descend, the darkness seems alive—watching, waiting.

choices.text: Proceed with caution through the darkness
Light a torch to guide your way

nodes.title: The Trial of Shadows
nodes.body:
In the darkness, your other senses sharpen. You begin to perceive things not with your eyes, but with something deeper. The shadows themselves seem to whisper secrets.

A voice speaks from everywhere and nowhere: 'To claim the Blade, you must become one with the shadow. Surrender your fear of the dark.'

nodes.title: Defying Darkness
nodes.body:
Your torch flares to life, pushing back the shadows. For a moment, you can see the path ahead—and the countless eyes watching from the darkness.

'Interesting,' whispers a voice. 'You bring light into our domain. Bold... or foolish. Perhaps both. Very well—prove your worth through knowledge.'

nodes.title: The Blade of Shadows
nodes.body:
At the heart of the cavern, suspended in a column of absolute darkness, floats the Blade of Shadows. It seems to drink in the light around it, leaving only void.

As your fingers close around the hilt, the blade speaks to you in whispers—secrets of your enemies, truths hidden from the world, knowledge that could elevate or destroy.

nodes.title: The Golden Treasury
nodes.body:
The Staff of Ages lies within the Golden Circle's most secure vault—a treasury said to contain the accumulated wealth of a thousand years. The vault is located in their capital, hidden beneath the Grand Exchange.

Gaining access requires either incredible wealth, or incredible cunning.

choices.text: Bribe your way past the guards

nodes.title: The Price of Entry
nodes.body:
The guards accept your coin with practiced discretion. 'The vault is through there,' one says quietly. 'You have one hour before the shift change. After that, we never saw you.'

You slip through the secret door into the treasury's outer chambers. Piles of gold and jewels line the walls—but you're here for something more valuable.

choices.text: Search for the Staff of Ages

nodes.title: Professional Courtesy
nodes.body:
Your standing with the Golden Circle grants you an audience with the Treasury Master. 'The Staff of Ages?' he muses. 'A significant request. But you've proven your value to the Circle.'

He hands you a golden key. 'The inner vault. Take what you need—but remember, the Circle always collects on its debts.'
nodes.speaker: Treasury Master

choices.text: Accept the key and your obligation

nodes.title: The Staff of Ages
nodes.body:
The Staff of Ages stands in a crystal case at the center of the inner vault. Unlike the gold around it, the staff is simple—wooden, ancient, worn smooth by countless hands over millennia.

But as you lift it, you understand its power. This staff has sealed treaties, ended wars, and built empires. It is the symbol of legitimate trade and fair dealing throughout the realm.

nodes.title: Dark Whispers
nodes.body:
A shadowy figure emerges from the darkness, their form shifting and unclear. 'I have watched you,' they whisper. 'Struggling to prove yourself, to earn the approval of those who see you as nothing more than a tool.'

The figure extends a hand wreathed in shadow. 'I offer you true power—power that needs no faction's blessing. All I ask is... flexibility in your loyalties.'
nodes.speaker: Shadow Broker

choices.text: I refuse your offer. My allies need me.
Tell me more about this... power.

nodes.title: The Shadow Broker
nodes.body:
The Shadow Broker leads you to a hidden chamber beneath the city. Maps and documents cover the walls—intelligence on every faction, every leader, every secret.

'Power requires knowledge,' they say, producing a scroll inscribed with dark symbols. 'Sign this pact, and all of this becomes yours. The factions will never know you serve a higher purpose... until it's too late.'
nodes.speaker: Shadow Broker

choices.text: What exactly are you asking of me?
Sign the Dark Pact without hesitation
No. This is not the power I seek.

nodes.title: The Price of Power
nodes.body:
The Shadow Broker's form ripples with amusement. 'Cautious. Good. Very well—here are the terms.'

They gesture to the maps. 'You continue your rise within your faction. You share what you learn with me. And when the time comes—and it will come—you act on my instructions. Nothing more.'

Their voice drops. 'In return, you receive my network, my knowledge, and protection from those who would destroy you. The factions are doomed regardless. This way, you survive.'
nodes.speaker: Shadow Broker

choices.text: I want more. What else can you offer?
No deal. I won't be your puppet.

nodes.title: Sweetening the Deal
nodes.body:
The Shadow Broker laughs—a sound like whispers in an empty room. 'Ambitious! I like it.'

They reach into the darkness and produce a small vial filled with swirling shadows. 'This is the Essence of Shadows. Consume it, and you will be able to walk unseen when you wish. A useful gift for... delicate situations.'
nodes.speaker: Shadow Broker

choices.text: Even with this, my answer is no

nodes.title: Bound in Shadow
nodes.body:
You take the quill—carved from bone, dripping with ink that seems to move on its own—and sign your name. The moment you finish, the parchment dissolves into shadow and flows into your skin.

'It is done,' the Shadow Broker says with evident satisfaction. 'You are now one of mine. The pact cannot be broken—only fulfilled.'

They hand you the Dark Pact Scroll. 'Keep this as a reminder. When I call, you will answer.'
nodes.speaker: Shadow Broker

choices.text: I understand. Now give me what you promised.

nodes.title: The Spider's Web
nodes.body:
The Shadow Broker reveals the extent of their network. Spies in every faction. Assassins on retainer. Blackmail on half the nobility of the realm.

'Use these resources wisely,' they advise. 'Each favor spent must be repaid with information. And remember—I am always watching.'

They give you a small black token. 'Show this to any of my agents. They will know what it means.'
nodes.speaker: Shadow Broker

nodes.title: Walking Away
nodes.body:
The Shadow Broker's form seems to darken. 'A pity. You would have been useful.'

They gesture, and the shadows around you seem to press closer. 'Leave, then. But know this—you have seen my face, or what passes for it. You know of my existence. That knowledge... has a price.'

Before you can respond, the shadows engulf you. When they clear, you're standing in an alley, alone, with no sign of the hidden chamber.
nodes.speaker: Shadow Broker

choices.text: Get as far from here as possible

nodes.title: The Seer's Vision
nodes.body:
An ancient seer awaits you in a candlelit chamber, their blind eyes somehow seeing more than any mortal gaze. 'I have seen your thread in the tapestry of fate,' they whisper.

'There is a path before you—a path of sacrifice. Should danger threaten those you love, you may choose to give everything to save them. The amulet you carry, or may yet find, holds the key.'

The seer's words chill you. 'Remember: sacrifice is the greatest power of all.'
nodes.speaker: The Seer

choices.text: I will remember your words, Seer.

nodes.title: Elena's Plea
nodes.body:
You encounter Elena, a skilled scout whose network of informants spans the realm. Her eyes are filled with worry as she approaches.

'I need your help,' she says urgently. 'My brother has been captured by raiders. They'll kill him if someone doesn't act. I can't do this alone—but together, we might save him.'

Her skill and connections could prove invaluable, but the rescue mission will be dangerous.
nodes.speaker: Elena

choices.text: We'll save your brother together. Lead the way.
I'm sorry, but I cannot risk this mission.

nodes.title: Planning the Rescue
nodes.body:
Elena leads you to a secluded camp where she spreads out a rough map. 'The raiders have a base in the Broken Hills,' she explains. 'Maybe thirty of them, plus their leader—a brute named Korgan.'

She points to different approaches. 'We could hit them at night, when most are asleep. Or we could try to sneak in through the old mines. Or...' she hesitates, 'we could try to buy my brother's freedom.'
nodes.speaker: Elena

choices.text: We attack at night. Surprise is our advantage.
The mines sound safer. Let's avoid a direct fight.
What would they want for his release?

nodes.title: Under Cover of Darkness
nodes.body:
You and Elena wait until the small hours of the night, when even the guards grow drowsy. Moving through the raider camp is nerve-wracking—one wrong step could wake the entire band.

But your timing is perfect. You find Elena's brother, Tomas, bound in a cage near the center of camp. As you work on his bonds, Korgan himself emerges from his tent, alerted by some sixth sense.

choices.text: Fight Korgan while Elena frees Tomas
Grab Tomas and run for it

nodes.title: The Forgotten Mines
nodes.body:
The old mine tunnels are cramped and dark, but they lead directly beneath the raider camp. Elena moves with practiced ease, her scout training evident in every silent step.

You emerge in a storage cave connected to the prisoner area. Tomas is there, weak but alive. 'Elena?' he whispers, scarcely believing his eyes.

choices.text: Get him out through the mines

nodes.title: The Price of a Life
nodes.body:
Elena's face hardens. 'They want gold, of course. More than I have.' She pauses. 'But there's something else. Korgan mentioned he needs someone... disposed of. A rival who's been cutting into his territory.'

She looks at you with conflicted eyes. 'If we do this, we'd be helping raiders. But my brother would live.'

choices.text: We're not assassins. Let's find another way.

nodes.title: Duel in the Dark
nodes.body:
Korgan is a mountain of muscle and rage, his blade heavy enough to cleave you in two. But he's slow, and years of easy victories have made him careless.

You trade blows in the flickering torchlight, each strike echoing through the sleeping camp. Finally, you find an opening—and Korgan falls, clutching his side.

nodes.title: Desperate Flight
nodes.body:
You grab Tomas and run, Elena covering your retreat with well-placed arrows. The raiders scramble to pursue, but in the darkness and confusion, you have the advantage.

By dawn, you've put miles between you and the camp. Tomas is safe—battered and weak, but alive.

nodes.title: Seeds of Chaos
nodes.body:
While Elena helps Tomas through the tunnels, you take a moment to ensure the raiders won't be troubling anyone soon. Their food stores go into the mud. Their weapons find new homes in crevices. Their horses' tethers develop mysterious weaknesses.

By the time they realize what's happened, you'll be long gone—and they'll have bigger problems than one escaped prisoner.

nodes.title: The Dark Bargain
nodes.body:
The rival is a merchant named Gareth—a man who's been undercutting Korgan's smuggling operation. 'He operates out of the frontier town,' Elena says quietly. 'Korgan wants him dead. In exchange, Tomas goes free.'

This is murder, plain and simple. But the alternative is watching Elena's brother die.

choices.text: This is too far. We find another way.
For your brother... I'll do it.

nodes.title: Blood on Your Hands
nodes.body:
The deed is done. Gareth lies still, his life traded for Tomas's freedom. Elena says nothing when you return—but she knows. You can see it in her eyes.

Korgan keeps his word. Tomas is released, though he's confused about why the raiders suddenly showed such mercy. Neither you nor Elena enlighten him.

nodes.title: A Sister's Gratitude
nodes.body:
With Tomas safe, Elena's relief is palpable. 'I can never repay what you've done,' she says, clasping your hands. 'But I can offer you this: my skills, my network, my loyalty.'

She kneels before you in the old way. 'From this day forward, where you go, I follow. Your enemies are my enemies, and your goals are mine. I swear it.'
nodes.speaker: Elena

choices.text: I accept your oath. Welcome, Elena.

nodes.title: Parting Ways
nodes.body:
Elena's face falls, but she nods slowly. 'I understand. Everyone has their own battles to fight.' She turns away, her shoulders set with determination.

'I'll find another way. I always do.' Without another word, she disappears into the wilderness. You may never see her again.

nodes.title: Thorne's Offer
nodes.body:
A mysterious warrior named Thorne crosses your path—battle-scarred and cynical, but undeniably skilled. He watches you with calculating eyes.

'I've heard of your exploits,' Thorne says. 'You're either very brave or very foolish. Either way, interesting. I find myself... between employers at the moment. Perhaps we could benefit each other.'

His skills are legendary, but his loyalties are rumored to shift like sand.
nodes.speaker: Thorne

choices.text: Tell me more about yourself first.
Skills can be proven. Show me what you can do.
I prefer allies I can trust. Farewell.

nodes.title: A Warrior's Past
nodes.body:
Thorne's face darkens. 'You want my story? Fine. I served the Northern Alliance for fifteen years. Rose to captain. Commanded a hundred men.'

He spits on the ground. 'Then my lords decided that my garrison was... expendable. Sacrificed to buy time for their retreat. I'm the only one who survived.'

His eyes meet yours. 'Now I serve only myself. And whoever's willing to pay for my blade.'
nodes.speaker: Thorne

choices.text: That's a terrible betrayal. I understand your cynicism.
And how do I know you won't abandon me when things get hard?

nodes.title: Proving Ground
nodes.body:
Thorne smiles—the first genuine emotion you've seen from him. 'Fair enough. I respect that.'

He draws his blade and takes a fighting stance. 'Let's spar. Hold nothing back—I won't.'

choices.text: Draw your weapon and face him

nodes.title: Understanding
nodes.body:
Something shifts in Thorne's expression. The hard cynicism softens, just slightly. 'Most people hear my story and assume I'm a traitor waiting to happen. You're different.'

He extends his hand. 'I don't give my loyalty easily anymore. But I'll give you this: honest work, honest fighting, and I'll never stab you in the back. That's more than most would promise.'
nodes.speaker: Thorne

choices.text: Then we have an accord. Welcome, Thorne.

nodes.title: The Mercenary's Code
nodes.body:
Thorne laughs bitterly. 'You're asking the right questions. Here's my answer: I've never broken a contract. Not once. When I'm hired, I stay hired until the job is done or I'm dead.'

He leans forward. 'My former lords didn't hire me—I served out of loyalty, and look where that got me. Contracts are cleaner. You pay, I fight. Simple. Honest. No betrayals.'
nodes.speaker: Thorne

choices.text: Fair enough. What are your terms?
I need more than a mercenary. I need someone who believes in the cause.

nodes.title: Blades Cross
nodes.body:
The duel is intense but controlled. Thorne is everything the rumors suggested—fast, precise, and creative. You find yourself pressed harder than you have in months.

But you hold your own. After a dozen exchanges, Thorne steps back and sheathes his blade. 'Impressive. You've got skill. More importantly, you've got heart.'

He nods with what might be respect. 'I'll fight beside you.'
nodes.speaker: Thorne

choices.text: The feeling is mutual. Welcome to the team.

nodes.title: The Contract
nodes.body:
'Simple,' Thorne says. 'I get a share of any spoils. You cover my expenses—food, equipment, healing. And if things go truly sideways, you don't expect me to die for a lost cause.'

He pauses. 'In return, I give you the best fighting arm you'll ever have, tactical advice from two decades of warfare, and absolute loyalty as long as the contract holds.'
nodes.speaker: Thorne

choices.text: The 'not dying for a lost cause' clause concerns me.

nodes.title: Honest Negotiations
nodes.body:
'Look,' Thorne says, 'I'm not going to charge a dragon single-handed because you ordered me to. But I'm not a coward either. I've held the line when others ran. I've faced death more times than I can count.'

He meets your gaze. 'What I won't do is throw my life away for nothing. If you're the type to spend lives like copper coins, we're done here. If not... we'll be fine.'
nodes.speaker: Thorne

choices.text: I value my allies' lives. You have my word.

nodes.title: The Sellsword
nodes.body:
Thorne clasps your arm in the warrior's grip. 'Then we have an accord. I'll gather my gear and meet you at the next town.'

As he turns to leave, he pauses. 'For what it's worth—I've got a good feeling about this. Don't make me regret it.'
nodes.speaker: Thorne

nodes.title: The Sellsword's Departure
nodes.body:
Thorne shrugs, his expression returning to its usual mask of cynicism. 'Your loss. But I won't beg for work.'

He turns and walks away, not looking back. A skilled warrior, lost to pride—or perhaps wisdom. Time will tell if you made the right choice.

nodes.title: The Vault Job
nodes.body:
Rumors speak of a hidden vault beneath the old fortress—filled with treasures and secrets that could change the balance of power. The entrance is heavily guarded, but a clever approach might succeed where force would fail.

Do you risk the heist, or move on to more pressing matters?

choices.text: Plan and execute the vault heist
The risk is too great. Press on toward Act 3.

nodes.title: Gathering the Team
nodes.body:
A job this big requires careful planning. You meet with potential partners at a dimly-lit tavern to discuss the approach.

Three specialists offer their services: a locksmith who knows the vault's mechanisms, a distraction artist who can draw away the guards, and a former insider who knows the patrol routes.

choices.text: The distraction will give us more time

nodes.title: Night of the Heist
nodes.body:
The night arrives. The fortress looms against the stars, its guards patrolling with clockwork precision. Your team moves into position.

You have three possible entry points: the main gate during a guard change, a sewer entrance that leads to the basement, or the roof via a neighboring building.

nodes.title: Perfect Timing
nodes.body:
Your insider's information proves accurate. During the guard change, there's a seventeen-second window when the gate is unwatched. You slip through like shadows, your heart pounding.

Inside, the fortress is eerily quiet. The vault entrance is just ahead—but so are the night guards.

nodes.title: The Underbelly
nodes.body:
The sewers are foul but unguarded. You wade through darkness and worse, following the rough map your contacts provided.

After what feels like hours, you emerge in the fortress basement—not far from the vault. But the door here is locked with a mechanism you've never seen before.

nodes.title: From Above
nodes.body:
Your distraction specialist triggers chaos in the market square—a fire that draws guards from their posts. You scale the neighboring building and leap to the fortress roof.

From here, a skylight offers access to the interior. The vault is three floors below.

nodes.title: Alarm!
nodes.body:
The door gives way with a crash that echoes through the fortress. Within seconds, alarm bells ring throughout the building.

You have minutes at best before guards swarm your position. Whatever you do, you'll have to do it fast.

choices.text: Rush to the vault before they arrive

nodes.title: The Final Lock
nodes.body:
The vault door is a masterwork of dwarven engineering—a massive iron portal covered in intricate mechanisms. Without the proper key, bypassing it seems impossible.

But you didn't come this far to be stopped by a door.

nodes.title: The Treasure Room
nodes.body:
Against all odds, you breach the vault. Ancient treasures glitter in the torchlight—gold, jewels, and artifacts of forgotten ages. But more valuable than any treasure is the information you find: documents revealing the enemy's plans.

This intelligence could prove decisive in the battles ahead.

choices.text: Fill your bags with treasure too

nodes.title: Clean Getaway
nodes.body:
Traveling light, you slip out of the fortress the same way you came. The guards are none the wiser—by the time they discover the theft, you'll be miles away.

The intelligence you've secured could change everything. Names, dates, troop movements—the enemy's entire war plan laid bare.

nodes.title: Weighted Down
nodes.body:
The treasure slows you down. You barely make it out before the guards discover the breach. Shouts echo behind you as you flee into the night, gold coins spilling from your overstuffed bags.

You're richer than you've ever been—but you've also made powerful enemies.

choices.text: Keep running—the treasure is worth it

nodes.title: Southern Exploration
nodes.body:
Your travels take you through the southern territories. The landscape here is wild and ancient, dotted with ruins from civilizations long forgotten.

Several sites catch your attention: a ruined watchtower that might hold useful maps, an overgrown battlefield where treasures might be buried, and a mysterious cave mouth that locals avoid.

nodes.title: The Fallen Sentinel
nodes.body:
The watchtower must have been impressive once—now it's little more than crumbling walls and a collapsed staircase. But as you pick through the rubble, you find something valuable.

Wedged between fallen stones, protected from the elements, is another fragment of the ancient map. This one shows secret passages into what appears to be a mountain fortress.

choices.text: Memorize the details but leave the map

nodes.title: Field of the Fallen
nodes.body:
The battlefield has been reclaimed by nature, but the signs of ancient warfare remain. Rusted weapons peek from the grass. Crumbling monuments mark where leaders fell.

As you explore, you disturb something—a skeletal hand reaching from the earth, clutching a tarnished ring. The ring bears a symbol you don't recognize... but it pulses with faint magical energy.

choices.text: Leave the dead to their rest

nodes.title: The Ring's Power
nodes.body:
As you slide the ring onto your finger, shadows seem to gather around you. For a moment, the world dims—then clears, leaving you with a strange new awareness.

You can feel shadows now, sense them as living things. And if you focus... you can make yourself harder to see. A useful ability, though one that comes with an unsettling sensation.

nodes.title: The Cave of Whispers
nodes.body:
The cave mouth yawns before you, exhaling cold air that carries faint whispers. The locals call it cursed, but you sense something more—not malevolence, but sorrow.

As you enter, the whispers grow clearer. They speak of the past, of a great betrayal, of secrets buried to protect the innocent.

nodes.title: The Hidden Shrine
nodes.body:
The cave opens into a natural chamber, and there—impossible but undeniable—stands a small shrine. It predates all the factions, perhaps all recorded history.

The whispers coalesce into words: 'Seeker, you have found what was hidden. Take our blessing, and remember: when the darkness comes, the light of sacrifice can banish it forever.'

nodes.title: Further Discoveries
nodes.body:
The southern territories have more secrets to reveal. You've already found valuable treasures, but your instincts tell you there's more to discover.

Do you continue exploring, or head toward the conclusion of Act 2?

nodes.title: The Secret Route
nodes.body:
Before leaving the southern territories, you review what you've learned. The map fragments, if you have both, reveal something extraordinary—a hidden path that leads directly to the heart of the final conflict.

This route would let you bypass heavily defended areas in Act 3...

choices.text: Commit the hidden route to memory

nodes.title: Storm Clouds
nodes.body:
As Act 2 draws to a close, dark clouds gather on the horizon—both literally and figuratively. The faction conflicts are reaching their peak, and the final confrontation approaches.

Your alliances are set. Your path—whether toward victory, sacrifice, betrayal, or neutrality—grows clearer with each step. The items you've gathered and the choices you've made will determine your fate.

Act 3 awaits, and with it, the ending of your story.

items.name: Crown of the North
items.description: An ancient crown worn by the first kings of the Northern Alliance. It radiates an aura of command and legitimacy, marking its bearer as a true leader.

items.name: Blade of Shadows
items.description: A legendary blade forged in darkness by the founders of the Shadow Conclave. It whispers secrets to its wielder and strikes unseen.

items.name: Staff of Ages
items.description: A staff of immense magical power, passed down through generations of the Golden Circle. It represents wealth, wisdom, and the patience of ages.

items.name: Dark Pact Scroll
items.description: A scroll inscribed with binding magic and signed in blood. It represents a pact with the Shadow Broker and marks the path toward betrayal.

items.name: Map Fragment (South)
items.description: The second fragment of an ancient map, detailing secret passages into the enemy stronghold. Combined with the northern fragment, it reveals hidden routes.

items.name: Vault Key
items.description: A master key obtained during the vault heist. It may unlock other secrets in the realm.
